goal: Capture counts-only Codex token usage for future bounded development tasks and make measured run records easy to fill
acceptance_criteria: Start snapshot identifies the current root Codex thread from CODEX_THREAD_ID or an explicit argument and records only safe session metadata and cumulative usage counts
Finish snapshot includes spawned agent descendants, excludes guardian/helper sessions, and computes non-negative deltas without summing cumulative snapshots
Raw prompts, messages, tool results, code snippets, file paths, and credentials never enter usage artifacts or terminal output
Counts can populate a draft workflow run record with provenance, while unknown fields remain null; documentation explains timing, model choice, quality metrics, and a controlled experiment
Synthetic tests cover task attribution, missing counters, duplicate snapshots, negative deltas, and private-content non-disclosure
